## Change

Describe the final user or operational behavior and why it changed.

## Validation

List the automated checks and any production evidence that reviewers can verify.

## Documentation and privacy

- [ ] `README.md` and `docs/FEATURES.md` describe every new or changed feature, or this pull request is an internal change with no catalog impact.
- [ ] The affected topic/runbook documents permissions, dependencies, failure behavior and operations.
- [ ] Public changes contain no credentials, private holdings/prices, user IDs, raw workbook data or private runtime records.
